Definition: from G4253 and G5021; to pre-arrange, i.e. prescribe:--before appoint.
BiblicalUsage: Protasso means to pre-arrange, to appoint beforehand. It appears once, in Paul's sermon at Athens: God hath made of one blood all nations of men, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that no nation is an accident: God set its times and its borders before it ever existed, and He set mine too.
